name: Inda Karane: Turnabout Tsundere
storyline:
A pretend courtroom battle between a pretend defense attorney and a pretend prosecutor. Based on Nozawa Yukiko and Nakamura Rikito's manga series: The 100 Girlfriends who really, really, really, really, really love you!

Take on the role of Inda Karane, a tsundere with a short temper and an out-of-the-box way of thinking. She chooses to take up the role of a lawyer, fighting against all odds to find the truth!

She'll be going up against Eiai Nano, a kuudere so dedicated to efficiency that she might often be railroaded into only finding one path to the truth. She chooses to take up the role of a prosecutor, as she wishes to efficiently figure out the truth in court.

A fun distraction turned serious personal journey, Karane learns what it means to seek the truth, as she has to confront some bleak truths along her path. Does she have what it takes to figure every truth out? And is it worth it to expose them all?
summary:
A fangame make by Shizuka Studio, A 100 Girlfriends fangame inspired by Ace Attorney's iconic courtroom battles! It features an original story mainly focused on Karane as she tries to fight for the truth against all odds.
Experience Inda Karane's (pretend) courtroom battles with Eiai Nano, as they try to prove the defendant guilty or not so guilty!
